QuestInfo.name: [Attack on Titan] A Difficult Situation
QuestInfo.0: You've arrived at a place called Wall Rose. Many refugees have gathered here.
QuestInfo.1: The refugees at Wall Rose look weary and beaten. Talk to the kid who looks on the verge of tears.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to talk to a particularly sad-looking kid, but he is simply too hungry to talk.
